  - text: CLASS 11 • CONIC SECTIONS
  - heading "Normal to a Parabola" [level=1]
  - paragraph: Move the parameter t to see the tangent and normal at P(at², 2at), verify slopes are negative reciprocals, and confirm the normal passes through P.
  - text: ~18 min ADVANCED CONCEPT geometry2d
  - main:
    - heading "⚗ INTERACTIVE NORMAL LAB" [level=2]
    - article:
      - text: Parameter t
      - slider "Normal parameter t": "1.5"
      - status: "1.50"
      - text: "Also try:"
      - button "-2"
      - button "-1"
      - button "-0.5"
      - button "0"
      - button "0.5"
      - button "1"
      - button "2"
    - img "Interactive parabola normal graph": Chord Tangent Angle P(2.25, 3.00) Tangent Normal
    - text: Parabola y²=4x Tangent ty=x+t² Normal y=-tx+2t+t³ Point P(t²,2t)
    - button "Point":
      - img
      - text: Point
    - button "Pan":
      - img

    - strong: a=1 Set a
    - complementary:
      - article:
        - heading "◆ POINT AND LINES" [level=2]
        - paragraph: P(at²,2at)
        - strong: P(2.25, 3.00)
        - paragraph: Tangent ty=x+at²
        - strong: y=0.67x+1.50
        - paragraph: Normal y=-tx+2at+at³
        - strong: y=-1.50x+6.375
      - article:
        - heading "◆ SLOPES AND PERPENDICULARITY" [level=2]
        - paragraph:
          - text: Slope of tangent mt=1/t
          - strong: "0.666667"
        - paragraph:
          - text: Slope of normal mn=-t
          - strong: "-1.500000"
        - paragraph:
          - text: Product mt × mn=-1
          - strong:
            - text: "-1.000000"
            - img
      - article:
        - heading "◆ ANGLE BETWEEN LINES" [level=2]
        - paragraph:
          - text: θ=arctan |(mn-mt)/(1+mtmn)|
          - strong:
            - text: 90.00°
            - img
      - article:
        - heading "◆ NORMAL PASSES THROUGH P" [level=2]
        - paragraph: "Substitute P(2.25, 3.00) into normal:"
        - paragraph:
          - text: LHS y=3.00 = RHS 3.00
          - img
      - article:
        - 'heading "◆ SPECIAL CASE: t=0" [level=2]'
        - paragraph: When t=0, P=(0,0). The tangent is the y-axis (x=0), which has undefined slope. The normal is y=0, the x-axis, with slope 0. They are perpendicular.
        - img
